Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; width: 240px; height: 294px; overflow: hidden; background: #efefeb; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 294px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
  preserveDrawingBuffer: true,
  antialias: true
});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 294, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();

function makeBackground() {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = canvas.height = 64;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const image = ctx.createImageData(64, 64);
  let seed = 918273;
  for (let y = 0; y < 64; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < 64; x++) {
      seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
      const random = (seed / 4294967296 - 0.5) * 5;
      const nx = (x - 31.5) / 45;
      const ny = (y - 31.5) / 45;
      const edge = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny));
      const cloud = Math.sin(x * 0.31 + Math.sin(y * 0.17) * 2) *
                    Math.sin(y * 0.23 - x * 0.08) * 3;
      const value = 249 - edge * 17 - (1 - y / 63) * 4 + random + cloud;
      const i = (y * 64 + x) * 4;
      image.data[i] = value;
      image.data[i + 1] = value;
      image.data[i + 2] = value - 2;
      image.data[i + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  texture.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  texture.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  return texture;
}
scene.background = makeBackground();

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xfff8df, 1.55));
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x827b50, 1.25));

const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4d5, 2.25);
key.position.set(-3.5, 7, 8);
scene.add(key);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xf4f6ff, 0.85);
fill.position.set(5, 3.5, 5);
scene.add(fill);

const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffe8, 1.1);
rim.position.set(-1, 5, -6);
scene.add(rim);

const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'yellow-humanoid';
scene.add(character);

const torsoGroup = new THREE.Group();
torsoGroup.name = 'torso';
character.add(torsoGroup);

const skinMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xc5b341,
  roughness: 1,
  metalness: 0
});
const headMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xcabe50,
  roughness: 1,
  metalness: 0
});
const legMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xc7ae38,
  roughness: 1,
  metalness: 0
});
const handMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0x55584b,
  roughness: 1,
  metalness: 0
});
const leftWristMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0x777849,
  roughness: 1
});

function smoothstep(a, b, x) {
  const v = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
  return v * v * (3 - 2 * v);
}

const torsoCurve = new THREE.SplineCurve([
  new THREE.Vector2(0.001, 2.02),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.48, 2.05),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.75, 2.22),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.98, 2.57),
  new THREE.Vector2(1.12, 3.06),
  new THREE.Vector2(1.16, 3.64),
  new THREE.Vector2(1.09, 4.25),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.90, 4.76),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.65, 5.15),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.44, 5.48),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.35, 5.70),
  new THREE.Vector2(0.001, 5.81)
]);
const torsoGeometry = new THREE.LatheGeometry(torsoCurve.getPoints(72), 64);
const tp = torsoGeometry.attributes.position;
const torsoColors = [];
const yellow = new THREE.Color(0xc5b13b);
const cream = new THREE.Color(0xe4dca2);
const workColor = new THREE.Color();

for (let i = 0; i < tp.count; i++) {
  let x = tp.getX(i);
  const y = tp.getY(i);
  let z = tp.getZ(i) * 0.82;
  x -= 0.14;
  tp.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);

  const bellyX = (x + 0.13) / 0.91;
  const bellyY = (y - 3.56) / 1.08;
  const radius = Math.sqrt(bellyX * bellyX + bellyY * bellyY);
  const belly = (1 - smoothstep(0.57, 1.06, radius)) *
                smoothstep(0.08, 0.63, z);
  const mottle = Math.sin(x * 17.3 + y * 9.1) * Math.sin(z * 15.7 - y * 4.3) * 0.025;
  workColor.copy(yellow).lerp(cream, belly * 0.94);
  workColor.offsetHSL(0, 0, mottle);
  torsoColors.push(workColor.r, workColor.g, workColor.b);
}
torsoGeometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(torsoColors, 3));
torsoGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
const torso = new THREE.Mesh(torsoGeometry, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors: true,
  roughness: 1,
  metalness: 0
}));
torso.name = 'pear-shaped-body-with-cream-belly';
torsoGroup.add(torso);

const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
headGroup.name = 'head';
character.add(headGroup);

const headGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 36);
const hp = headGeometry.attributes.position;
for (let i = 0; i < hp.count; i++) {
  const x = hp.getX(i);
  const y = hp.getY(i);
  const z = hp.getZ(i);
  const cheek = 1 - y * 0.075;
  hp.setXYZ(i, x * 0.55 * cheek - 0.02, y * 0.59 + 5.81, z * 0.48);
}
headGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeometry, headMaterial);
head.name = 'drooping-oval-head';
headGroup.add(head);

const eyesGroup = new THREE.Group();
eyesGroup.name = 'eyes';
headGroup.add(eyesGroup);

const faceLineMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0x716c35,
  roughness: 1,
  transparent: true,
  opacity: 0.68
});

function addFaceCurve(parent, name, points, radius, material) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 20, radius, 7, false), material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

addFaceCurve(eyesGroup, 'left-sleepy-eye', [
  new THREE.Vector3(-0.34, 6.035, 0.385),
  new THREE.Vector3(-0.25, 6.010, 0.438),
  new THREE.Vector3(-0.14, 6.020, 0.458)
], 0.012, faceLineMaterial);

addFaceCurve(eyesGroup, 'right-sleepy-eye', [
  new THREE.Vector3(0.105, 6.025, 0.462),
  new THREE.Vector3(0.205, 6.005, 0.438),
  new THREE.Vector3(0.305, 6.025, 0.389)
], 0.011, faceLineMaterial);

const nose = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14), headMaterial);
nose.name = 'subtle-nose';
nose.scale.set(0.065, 0.052, 0.045);
nose.position.set(-0.005, 5.855, 0.477);
headGroup.add(nose);

const mouthGroup = new THREE.Group();
mouthGroup.name = 'mouth';
headGroup.add(mouthGroup);
const mouthMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0x615c32,
  roughness: 1,
  transparent: true,
  opacity: 0.78
});
addFaceCurve(mouthGroup, 'small-flat-mouth', [
  new THREE.Vector3(-0.205, 5.605, 0.410),
  new THREE.Vector3(-0.105, 5.600, 0.440),
  new THREE.Vector3(0.015, 5.600, 0.451),
  new THREE.Vector3(0.175, 5.605, 0.421)
], 0.014, mouthMaterial);

function capsuleBetween(a, b, radius, material, name) {
  const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
  const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
  const direction = end.clone().sub(start);
  const length = direction.length();
  const geometry = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(
    radius,
    Math.max(0.01, length - radius * 2),
    8,
    16
  );
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
    direction.normalize()
  );
  return mesh;
}

const leftArm = new THREE.Group();
leftArm.name = 'left-arm';
character.add(leftArm);
leftArm.add(capsuleBetween(
  [-0.99, 4.77, -0.01], [-1.24, 3.72, 0.015],
  0.205, skinMaterial, 'left-upper-arm'
));
leftArm.add(capsuleBetween(
  [-1.23, 3.75, 0.015], [-1.48, 2.77, 0.09],
  0.155, skinMaterial, 'left-forearm'
));
leftArm.add(capsuleBetween(
  [-1.42, 3.00, 0.075], [-1.52, 2.64, 0.11],
  0.142, leftWristMaterial, 'left-shadowed-wrist'
));

const rightArm = new THREE.Group();
rightArm.name = 'right-arm';
character.add(rightArm);
rightArm.add(capsuleBetween(
  [0.76, 4.76, -0.025], [1.035, 3.74, 0.005],
  0.19, skinMaterial, 'right-upper-arm'
));
rightArm.add(capsuleBetween(
  [1.035, 3.76, 0.005], [1.16, 2.67, 0.085],
  0.14, skinMaterial, 'right-forearm'
));

function buildHand(name, position, rotation, right = false) {
  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = name;
  hand.position.set(...position);
  hand.rotation.z = rotation;
  character.add(hand);

  const palm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 18), handMaterial);
  palm.name = 'palm';
  palm.scale.set(right ? 0.155 : 0.18, right ? 0.23 : 0.255, 0.115);
  hand.add(palm);

  const lengths = right ? [0.25, 0.31, 0.30, 0.23] : [0.28, 0.36, 0.34, 0.26];
  const xs = [-0.125, -0.042, 0.045, 0.125];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const spread = (i - 1.5) * 0.035;
    hand.add(capsuleBetween(
      [xs[i], -0.11, 0.005],
      [xs[i] + spread, -0.11 - lengths[i], 0.015],
      0.037,
      handMaterial,
      'finger-' + (i + 1)
    ));
  }

  const side = right ? -1 : 1;
  hand.add(capsuleBetween(
    [side * 0.135, 0.055, 0.005],
    [side * 0.235, -0.18, 0.025],
    0.045,
    handMaterial,
    'thumb'
  ));
  return hand;
}

buildHand('left-hand', [-1.59, 2.29, 0.11], -0.12, false);
buildHand('right-hand', [1.19, 2.27, 0.105], 0.075, true);

function makeLeg(name, side) {
  const isLeft = side === 'left';
  const points = [
    new THREE.Vector2(0.001, -0.06),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.275, -0.045),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.315, 0.08),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.34, 0.48),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.395, 1.12),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.465, 1.78),
    new THREE.Vector2(isLeft ? 0.50 : 0.485, 2.34),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.001, 2.39)
  ];
  const geometry = new THREE.LatheGeometry(new THREE.SplineCurve(points).getPoints(48), 48);
  const p = geometry.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const x = p.getX(i);
    const y = p.getY(i);
    const z = p.getZ(i) * 0.88;
    const upperX = isLeft ? -0.49 : 0.38;
    const lowerX = isLeft ? -0.76 : 0.30;
    const blend = 1 - smoothstep(0.05, 2.25, y);
    const centerX = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(upperX, lowerX, blend);
    p.setXYZ(i, x + centerX, y, z);
  }
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const leg = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, legMaterial);
  leg.name = name;
  return leg;
}

const legsGroup = new THREE.Group();
legsGroup.name = 'legs';
character.add(legsGroup);
legsGroup.add(makeLeg('left-leg', 'left'));
legsGroup.add(makeLeg('right-leg', 'right'));

const cameras = {
  ref: new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.7755102, 2.7755102, 3.4, -3.4, 0.1, 100)
};
cameras.ref.name = 'reference-camera';
cameras.ref.position.set(0, 3.4, 12);
cameras.ref.lookAt(0, 3.4, 0);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, cameras.ref);
}

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras,
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};

render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
